subject: Bad number on L-4412
body: Hi, lead L-4412 Margaret Holloway out of Tampa has a disconnected number. I tried it 4 times over two days and got the not in service message. Can I get a replacement? Thanks, Dan

subject: Double charge
body: I see two charges for $1,450 on my card on the 3rd. Only one should have gone through. Please refund the extra one.

subject: Drop Arizona
body: Hey team, AZ has not been performing for us. Can you take Arizona out of my targeting and push that volume into California? Keep Nevada as is.

subject: No show Thursday
body: The 10:30 appointment on Thursday with Robert Kessler never picked up the phone. I waited 20 minutes and called twice. Is this counted as a no-show on my account, and will I get a rebook?

subject: Lead delivery failed
body: Delivery to https://crm.goldenyearsfe.example/hooks/leads returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized. Retries 3/3 failed. We have not received leads in our CRM since yesterday evening.

subject: Cancel my account
body: We are shutting down the outbound side of the agency at the end of this month. Please cancel my subscription and confirm I will not be billed again after that.

subject: Referral program?
body: Do you guys have a referral program? I know another planner in Madison who might be interested and I would like to know if I get anything for sending him your way.

subject: Lead from Connecticut
body: Lead L-9023, Tony Ricci, lives in Stamford CT. We only buy NY and NJ and I cannot work him with my license. Please credit this one.

subject: March invoice
body: Can you resend the March invoice? My accountant needs a PDF with our business name on it, not my personal name.

subject: Not enough money
body: Most of the leads this week say they have maybe $20k saved, some even less. Our minimum is $50k for annuities. Seven of them were like this, L-5530 through L-5536. Can we get credits for these?

subject: Cant log in
body: I keep getting invalid password on the portal and the reset email never shows up. Checked spam too. Email on file is the one I'm writing from.

subject: Add Indiana
body: We just got licensed in Indiana. Can you add IN to our campaign? And honestly I'd like to scale back Michigan volume a bit, it's too much for us to follow up on.

subject: Appointment times
body: A prospect got booked for 7:15am my time on Tuesday. Nobody over 65 wants a call that early and I'm not even at my desk. Can we set it so nothing is booked before 9am Central?

subject: She never signed up
body: Spoke with Patricia Dunn (L-3318) and she told me she never filled out anything and thinks it was a scam. She got really upset. What do I do with this lead?

subject: Looking at other options
body: Another vendor offered us leads for about 30% less per lead. Before I decide, is there anything you can do on pricing? Otherwise I'll probably move over when this month wraps up.

subject: New card
body: My company card was replaced and the old one expires. How do I update the payment method on file before the next billing date?

subject: Double booked
body: I have two appointments on my calendar for Tuesday at 2pm, with Gerald Pierce and Linda Moss. Can one of them be moved? I can't take both.

subject: Pause for two weeks
body: I'll be out of the office from the 15th to the 29th. Please pause all lead delivery for Texas, Oklahoma and Louisiana during that time and turn it back on the 30th.

subject: Shared lead
body: I called L-6107 (Kevin Tran, Sacramento) within 5 minutes and he said three other agents had already called him that morning. These are supposed to be exclusive. This is the third time this month.

subject: Hiring?
body: Are you hiring right now? I have experience in insurance lead gen and would like to send my resume. Who should I send it to?

subject: Refund for junk leads
body: Five leads from last Friday were all fake names with bogus phone numbers (L-7201 to L-7205). I want the money for these back on my card, not just credit toward future leads.

subject: Add South Carolina
body: We just got our SC license. Please add South Carolina to our states and keep NC and VA the same.

subject: Zapier not receiving leads
body: Our Zapier zap hasn't gotten any new leads since Monday morning, but I can see they're in the portal. Nothing on our end changed. Can someone check the integration?

subject: Prospect didnt answer
body: Three of the appointments you booked this week for me didn't answer when I called at the scheduled time. Do you confirm with them beforehand? What is your policy on rebooking?

subject: Not renewing
body: Just letting you know we won't be renewing after this month. The annuity market has gotten tougher for us and we're cutting back on marketing. Thanks for your help.

subject: Medicare leads?
body: Do you sell Medicare supplement leads too? Wondering if that's something you plan on offering in Texas.

subject: Invoice higher than expected
body: The invoice this month is $4,980 but I calculated about 83 leads at $55 which is around $4,565. Can you break down what the extra charges are?

subject: App keeps crashing
body: The Acme app on my iPhone crashes every time I open a lead. Updated to the latest version already. iOS 17. I can't see my new leads on the go.

subject: Wrong product
body: Several of my leads this week (L-7310, L-7314, L-7322) said they were looking for Medicare Advantage plans, not final expense. They didn't know what I was calling about. Please look into it.

subject: Reschedule rules
body: If a prospect asks to move their appointment, can I change it myself in the portal or does it have to go through you? Also, are the times shown in Eastern or the prospect's time zone?

subject: L-7781 wrong state
body: Lead L-7781 Carol Jensen is in Des Moines, Iowa. I'm not licensed there, and Iowa isn't one of my states. Please replace.

subject: More volume and CT
body: Results have been good so I'd like to bump up my volume by about 50%. Also can you add Connecticut to my campaign? We just got our license there.

subject: Billing alert: monthly cap exceeded
body: Account C-03 delivered 96 leads against a monthly cap of 80. 16 leads billed at overage rate. Charge of $1,120 will post on the next invoice. Reply to dispute.

subject: Receipt needed
body: Can you email me a receipt for the payment on card ending 4421 from last week? I need it for my expense report.

subject: Lead quality has dropped
body: Over the last two weeks nearly every lead I've talked to says they're not interested or don't remember filling out a form. It used to be much better. Is something different with the ads?

subject: Closing my agency
body: I'm retiring and closing Golden Years at the end of the month. Please cancel everything and let me know what I need to do to close the account.
